name: Naturalisation as a British Overseas Territories Citizen (BOTC)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires holding a valid Permanent Resident Permit.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain and hold a valid Permanent Resident Permit (e.g. via ai_permanent_residence_arbi.json).

requirements.blocker_text: Must provide all work permits held over the last 5 years, together with job letters covering the same period.
Requires an interview at the Attorney General's Chambers, and possibly an English-language proficiency test; a letter of residency from an Anguillian or BOTC is also required.

evidence_required.document: Fully completed, signed, and dated application form
All pages of every passport held since first arrival in Anguilla
All work permits and job letters covering the last 5 years
Letter of residency from an Anguillian or BOTC
Certified translations of any foreign-language documents
Non-refundable processing fee: EC$100.00 (paid to Inland Revenue Department)

sources.title: Government of Anguilla -- Naturalisation Tips: application requirements, documents, interview, and fees for naturalisation as a British Overseas Territories Citizen

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Anguilla's initial build. This is the genuine 'citizenship' (British Overseas Territories Citizenship, BOTC) track for Anguilla -- the one route in this country's dataset where leads_to_citizenship=true actually applies, in contrast to the three Belonger Status routes (see ai_belonger_status_descent.json's notes for the full explanation of that distinction). A UK Overseas Territories passport is then issued via the Passport Office (a separate administrative step, not modelled as its own route since it is purely document-issuance once BOTC status is held). The originally targeted source for this route, bom.gov.ai/naturalisation.php, failed with a DNS resolution error during initial research -- that domain appears to be dead or a defunct legacy mirror; gov.ai/service/vital-records/naturalisation-tips is the correct, current, live tier-1 replacement found in this pass. prerequisites is left null rather than pointing specifically at ai_permanent_residence_arbi, because the source requires 'a valid Permanent Resident Permit' generically, without naming which PR route -- ARBI is the only Permanent Residence route built for Anguilla in this pass, but others may exist that were not found. The English-language test is described as conditional/possible ('potentially'), not stated as a universal requirement, and is flagged accordingly rather than modelled as its own hard requirement. dual_citizenship_allowed is left null: British Overseas Territories Citizenship's interaction with other nationalities is governed by UK nationality law and was not independently confirmed at tier-1 in this pass.
